headline: Quavo says a new Migos album is on the way and could arrive around the group’s anniversary
body: Quavo says a new Migos album is on the way and could arrive around the group’s anniversary in January 2027. “We coming back with a Migos album... We almost ready to turn it in too… The anniversary for Migos is January, so you may get something then.” He also shut down the idea that it’ll continue the Culture series, saying, “No more Cultures.” The Baller Alert Show/YouTube.
